s: Hanhagat bet hakkisse ubo k"h seipim: bekol paam sheyyikkanes lebet hakkisse — yomar lehammalakim hamlavvim oto: "hitkabbedu mekubbadim ku'". Veakshav lo nahagu leomro, mippene sheen machaziqin et atzmenu leyire shamayim shehammalakim melavvim otanu:

Yehe tzanua bebet hakkisse, velo yegalleh et atzmo ad sheyyesheb. Velo yeleku shene anashim beyachad, ki eno midderek hatztzeniut. Veim mitpached lesheb yechidi — yukal acher lehanniach yado al rosho derek challon. Velo yedabber sham, veyisgor haddelet baado, mishshum tzeniut:
Im rotzeh lemashmesh bepi hattabbaat bitzror o beqesam kede liptoach neqabayv — yemashmesh qodem sheyyesheb, velo yemashmesh achar sheyyesheb, mippene sheqqasheh likshapim:
Im hutzrak lippanot veeno yakol — yelek arba ammot veyesheb, veyaamod veyesheb, veyaamod veyesheb ad sheyyippaneh, o yassiach dato middebarim acherim:
Lo yippaneh baamida:

Lo yegalleh atzmo, ki im: milleacharayv — tepach velo yoter, mishshum tzeniut, umillepanayv — tepachayim, demittok shehu docheq et atzmo ligdolim hu ba lide qetannim, vetzarik tepachayim mishshum qilluach me raglayim hannittazim lemerachoq. Veishsha lo tegalleh atzmah, ki im: milleachareha — tepach, umillepaneha — velo kelum:

Ukesheyyesheb — yekavven sheyyihyu panayv ledarom vaachorayv letzapon, o ippeka. Abal lo yesheb ben mizrach lemaarab, ben sheppanayv lemizrach ben sheppanayv lemaarab, mippene shehashshekina bemaarab, lepikak lo yaaseh tzerakayv lemaarab, velo lemizrach, mippene shehu keneged hammaarab. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemesek et raglayv, abal lehatil mayim — muttar apillu panayv lemaarab, ap-al-pi shemmegalleh et atzmo millepanayv:
Vaapillu lehasek raglayv, im yesh mechitztza letzad maarab — muttar lippanot samuk lammechitztza im machazir achorayv lemaarab, veim hammechitztza letzad mizrach — machazir achorayv lemizrach:

Keshem sheasur lippanot ben mizrach lemaarab — kak asur lishon ben mizrach lemaarab im ishto immo bammitta vedato leshammesh, ella yekavven shettehe rosh hammitta umargeloteha zeh letzapon vezeh ledarom. Venakon lehizzaher apillu en ishto immo:

Mi shei epshar lo beqallut lehaseb mittato ben tzapon ledarom — en alayv issur leshammesh mittato ben mizrach lemaarab. Veyesh lismok al seper hazzohar, shemmatzrik sheyyehe davqa rosh hammitta umargeloteha zeh lemizrach vezeh lemaarab:

Hammetil mayim min hatztzopim (perush kol maqom sebibot yerushalayim sheyyekolin lirot et bet hammiqdash mishsham umishsham veelak en yekolim lirot — niqra oto maqom tzopim) ulepanim — lo yatil upanayv mammash kelappe haqqodesh, ella yachazir panayv letzad acher meat:

Keshennipneh bemaqom sheen mechitztza mapseqet beno leben adam kegon bebiqa — tzarik lehitracheq ad maqom shello yukal chabero lirot et mah shemmegalleh mibbesaro beshaa shennipneh. Veap-al-pi shechabero shomea qol ittusho shellematta — apillu hake en tzarik lehitracheq yoter. Veim yesh mechitztza mapseqet beno libne adam, ben shennipneh achore kotel bayit, ben shennipneh bebiqa achore gader — yakol lippanot miyyad samuk lammechitztza ap-al-pi shechabero shomea qol ittusho shellematta — ap-al-pi-ken en tzarik lehitracheq kelal:
Lo yesheb veyippaneh bimhera ubechozeq, lepi shenniptach hanneqeb bechozqa venittaqim shinne hakkarkashta. Veken mittaam zeh, lo yeenos lidchoq et atzmo yoter midday:

Lo yeqannach et atzmo beyad yamin, mippene shebbeyamin qosher et hattepillin al hassemol, laken en rauy leqanneach et atzmo bah. Veitter yad — meqanneach bismolo shehu yamin shel kol adam. Vaapillu mi sheoseh kol maasayv beyamin ella shekkoteb bismol — lo yeqannach bismol shekkoteb bah, mippene shebbah qosher tepillin al hayyamin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman kaz saip t:
Tob lizzaher shello leqanneach baetzba haemtzai, shealayv hu korek retzua shel tepillin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman kaz saip ya:

Lo yeqannach bachatikat cheres sheenah chalaqa veyesh bah chiddudim qetannim, mippene hassakkana, shello yenatteq bah shinne hakkarkashta. Vaapillu beogne keli cheres shehem chalaqim veenam meqorim et habbasar — lo yeqannach bahem, mippene sheqqasheh likshapim. Velo yeqannach baasabim yebeshim, shehem chaddim umechattekim et habbasar. Veken bekol dabar shehaur sholetet bo — en meqannechin bo, mippene shehamqanneach bedabar shehaur sholetet bo — shinne hakkarkashta nosherot. Veakshav shebbatte kisot shellanu enan bassadeh — nahagu leqanneach bachatikat cheres chalaqa, deiqqar hachashash hu kevan shehacheres munnach bassadeh bimqom hepqer shemma yitteluhu hamkashshepim veyaasu bo kishshup, abal akshav shebbet hakkisse shellanu enan bimqom hepqer — lo chayshinan sheyyabo hacheres lide hamkashshepim. Veken nahagu akshav leqanneach bedabar shehaur sholetet bo veeno mazziq, upuq chazi may amma debar:

Lo yeqannach bitzror sheqqinnach bo chabero, mippene shemmebi et haadam lide tachtoniyyut. Veim nityabbesh haqqinnuach o sheeno meqanneach beoto hatztzad sheqqinnach chabero ella mitztzad acher beoto hatztzeror — let lan bah. Veim hu atzmo qinnach bo — bekol gavne let lan bah:

Kol hatztzeniut shennitbaer shetztzarik linhog bayyom — tzarik linhog gam ken ballayla, ella sheen tzarik lehitracheq. Veim en sham adam — yakol lippanot apillu birshut harabbim. Abal im yesh sham adam apillu nokri — asur lippanot bepanayv. Vekol zeh lippanot, abal lehashtin — muttar apillu bayyom bipne rabbim, im tzarik lekak, mishshum deikka sakkana im yaamid et atzmo:

Ap-al-pi sheen ishsha megalla et atzmah kelum bahatalat me raglayim — mikkol maqom lo taamod lehashtin keneged panayv shel ish, apillu keneged panayv shel tinoq, mishshum deikka chatziputa im tashtin bepanayv mammash. Abal litzdadin, sheenah mashtenet mammash bepanayv — let lan bah:

Tzarik leshapshep beyado hannitzotzot shel me raglayim hannittazim al gabbe raglayv, shello yetze bahen lachutz veyeraeh kikrut shopka sheen meme raglayv meqallechin ella shotetin, ukerut shopka eno molid, veyomru al banayv sheenam shello. Bammeh debarim amurim desaggi leh beshipshup — kesheochez baamma umashtin, veal derek sheyyitbaer leqamman. Abal im eno ochez baamma, mittok sheharbeh nitzotzot nittazin al raglayv, laken ap im meshapshep beyado — adayin yihyeh rishshuman nikkar, veyomru alayv shehu kerut shopka. Laken yashtin letok apar tachuach, o yaamod bemaqom gaboah veyashtin lemaqom namuk, o yashtin meyushshab, dibkol hanne gavne lekka lemechash lenitzotzot:

Yizzaher meod shello yeechoz baamma veyashtin, mippene shehu gorem sheyyotzi shikbat zera lebattala, im lo sheochez meatara ulematta letzad haaretz, diksheochez sham — eno ba lide chimmum kelal. Vaapillu im haeber kebar beqishshuy — muttar leechoz meatara ulematta. Vedavqa baamma asur leechoz — abal mesayyea hu babbetzim, mishshum sheeno mitchammem al yede kak:

Vekol zeh besheeno nasuy, o sheen ishto immo, o shehi nidda, abal im ishto tehora immo bair, kevan deyesh lo "pat besallo" — en yitzro toqepo kol kak, umuttar leechoz baamma apillu meatara ulemala letzad haggup. Umikkol maqom, middat chasidut lehizzaher apillu ishto immo, ki meachar sheheavon gadol kol kak shehu kemebi mabbul laolam — rauy laadam lehitracheq uleqaddesh atzmo bammuttar lo. Muttar leechoz baamma al yede matlit aba, sheeno mechammem, lehashtin o libdoq im raa qeri:

Lo huttar lannasuy leechoz baamma ella lehashtin, shehu tzorek haadam, shello yippelu nitzotzot al raglayv. Abal lehitchakkek, o libdoq et atzmo im raa qeri — asur apillu lenasuy veishto immo, vaapillu meatara ulematta — yesh lehachamir:
Kol hammashheh et atzmo millippanot keshehu tzarik linqabayv — hare zeh ober al "bal teshaqqetzu". Veim nitzrak liqtannim umashheh et atzmo — ober al "bal teshaqqetzu" veal "lo yihyeh beka aqar":
Yizzaher meod leqanneach heteb, ki tzoa bimqomah bemashshehu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman av saip v, ayyen sham. Veim epshar lo — tob sheyyirchatz bammayim:
